propositions: Link-sync tests currently exercise only single representatives of the relation vocabulary (blocks ~19× iterations, depends_on 0×), leaving unmapped relations untested and creating blind spots like bug c8ed where the outbound direction swap was not caught.
The outbound _diff_links emission path must be parametrized over all six relations with assertions on correct (jira_type, swap) tuples for mapped relations and empty lists for unmapped relations.
The REMOVE mutation path for outward Blocks links (which swap to inbound depends_on) is untested; a new test case must verify the direction-logic branch in outbound_links.py:193-202.

Test assertions must validate per-relation orientation semantics (e.g., depends_on swap is True, endpoint tuples swapped) rather than mere presence, so a regression in the swap fix would cause test failure.
